limits: No claim that repository main hashes equal current 187/183 runtime; no production SSH was used.
OWNERS is a module navigation list, not current deployment certification. Source-map timestamps are historical evidence.
HTML embedded JavaScript, CSS, systemd/nginx semantics, shell variable expansion and dynamic imports/subprocess routing need original source inspection.
Only selected code extensions are copied; SQL uses the official graphifyy sql extra. Config data and credentials are not copied.
Static links are candidates; confirm the exact publisher, source path, current commit and relevant tests before editing.
No model, document/PDF extraction, API keys, global hook, background watcher or production service is used.
Additional release directories must be added with a concrete current caller or publisher reference; excluded history remains in Git.

evidence_levels.publisher_mapping: 仓库发布器可直接确认所列关键映射；不证明整组文件或现场版本。
evidence_levels.partial_mapping: 仅有部分、历史或候选source-map；不能将整组视为现役。
evidence_levels.maintained_source: 按模块、测试分组或回填选择的维护源码；现役发布映射尚未逐文件核对。
